scenarios.name: Toggle camera autosave for an inactive copied view

scenario_steps.name: an empty part is active in the MCAD Software
Primary is the active view representation
an inactive copied view representation exists
its camera autosave option is checked
the user opens the copied view's context menu and expands Camera View
the user reopens the Camera View submenu
the user chooses Autosave Camera again
the user reopens the Camera View submenu
